claim: Item 116's zoom-out limit at the METROPOLIS cap. §8.8 defines k_min = max(0, k_fit − `view.zoomOutMarginStops`), with k_fit 'the largest k ≤ 34 with max(the bounds' width, height) ≤ the short side in CSS px × m_k'.
